PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
                                   MINUTES

A meeting of the Public Services Committee was held on Monday, August 3, 2026, in City Council
Chambers and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Dr. Michelle Aldrich, Chairwoman. Dr. Kathy Emmons, and Pete
Laybourn, and Dr. Nark Rinne,


                                    AGENDA ITEMS

6.     ORDINANCE 3” READING Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land west
                                        —




       of Roundtop Road and south of happy Jack Road.

Dr. Riirne moved to approve on 3 and final reading, seconded by Dr. Emmons. Motion carried
by unaninmus voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report and
Brad Emmons, AVI P.C., was available for questions.

7.     ORDINANCE      —


                         3 READING         Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
       Cheyenne, establishing the zoning classification of BP Business Park for land annexed
                                                              -




       to the City of Cheyenne, located west of Roundtop Road and south of 1-lappy Jack Road.

Dr. Emmons moved to approve on 3rd and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 12:04 p.m.
